HELD-OUT EVAL (2D control).

CONTROL ARM for costmodel_hetero_3d_v3. Identical fleet (eu-frankfurt-1 L40S:2 + us-west4 H100:1), identical windows, identical time_scale=2.0, identical ES config (window 256 / hop 64, sigma 0.5, sigma_min 0.02, seed 20260726). The ONLY difference is the parameter set: no per-class prefill scale, no KV-capacity queue normalization, no reference pin. prefill_rate and queue_rate stay at 1.0 on every replica, so this is GORGO exactly as published, dropped onto heterogeneous hardware with no awareness of it.

Purpose: measure what hardware-awareness is worth. The comparison of interest is held-out Apr 6 TTFT, 2D vs 3D, on the same fleet composition. Run in parallel with the 3D arm so both see the same network conditions -- the paper's own rationale for parallel policy runs.
